trace_pattern.purpose: Template for adding new traceability records.

fields.concept: Short name of the concept that ripples
fields.requirement: The specific rule that must hold across the system
fields.current_source_value: Snapshot of the authoritative value at time of trace creation
fields.affected_files: All files that consume the concept
fields.verification_checks: Which CHK rules in the consistency checker enforce this
fields.current_drift: Observed drift at time of trace creation, if any
fields.change_packet: Packet that addresses the drift, if any

adding_a_new_trace_protocol: When a new concept enters the system at severity S3+, add a trace.
Identify the source of truth (usually HS_FAST_REFRESH.json or a controlled item).
Map each affected file to a verification check in the consistency checker.
If no existing check covers the new concept, file a Phase-2 task to extend the checker.
